commands.name: status
commands.purpose: Read the board report: tasks in work, questions, held, later, failed and stuck tasks, hosts.

commands.name: wait
commands.purpose: Block until a task moves to ask, review with options, closed or failed; prints the move or tick.

commands.name: inbox
commands.purpose: Read one task: its text, folded state, answers and log.

commands.name: add
commands.use: taskq add <title> --goal G --acceptance A [--acceptance B..] [--scope P..] [--deps N..] [--type T] [--runtime R] [--priority 0|1|2] [--host H]
commands.purpose: File a new task; it starts held until `start`.

commands.name: start
commands.purpose: Admit held tasks after reading them back from the board.

commands.name: answer
commands.use: taskq answer N.K [M.K..] | taskq answer N --text A
commands.purpose: Relay the owner's answer to an open question; never answer for the owner.

commands.name: pick
commands.purpose: Mark the option the PM proposes to the owner; it is not an answer.

commands.name: steer
commands.purpose: Send text to the live worker of a doing task.

commands.name: requeue
commands.purpose: Send a task back to ready with the reason or fixes.

commands.name: later
commands.purpose: Park a task until a blocker closes or a time passes.

commands.name: approve
commands.purpose: Record the owner's approval of the current result of a gated task.

commands.name: issue
commands.purpose: Read any board issue, or add a comment or a label.

commands.name: reports
commands.purpose: List research and proposal reports waiting for the owner's decision.

commands.name: focus
commands.purpose: Choose which tasks this host admits; no arguments prints focus and labels.

commands.name: profile watch
commands.purpose: PM telemetry pass of this install: stalls, new or growing action errors, board failures, cadence per board.

commands.name: retro
commands.purpose: Open an owner session on use-case proposals from board history.
